title: Loan-Amount Part of the Appraisal Order Update Visit Charge
content:
The loan-amount part of the Appraisal Order update visit charge reads the base loan amount on the Mortgage Loan File the order supports: 1,500,000 dollars or more adds 120 dollars, 900,000 to 1,499,999.99 dollars adds 60 dollars, and a smaller base loan amount adds nothing. The loan-amount part is added into the standard update charge.

| Base loan amount on the Mortgage Loan File (USD) | Loan-amount part (USD) |
|---|---|
| 1500000.00 or more | 120.00 |
| 900000.00 to 1499999.99 | 60.00 |
| Under 900000.00 | 0.00 |

The base loan amount is the loan amount on the file before any financed upfront program fee.

*Hypothetical readings:* 899,999.99 adds nothing; 900,000.00 adds 60.00; 1,499,999.99 adds 60.00; 1,500,000.00 adds 120.00.
